ambiguity_notes: Spec says 'release of reset is synchronous to clk' but reset assertion is asynchronous; I assumed this means the rst_n deassertion is sampled on a rising clock edge to avoid metastability, while assertion is level-sensitive and immediately effective
Spec does not explicitly state what happens to dout when shift_out_en is low or done is low; I assumed dout is a don't-care (may hold last value or be 0) in those conditions

Spec says load_en causes a new load if asserted while done is high; it is ambiguous whether load_en during the encrypt phase is ignored or resets the encrypt; I assumed load_en during encrypt is ignored and only takes effect after done is asserted or after reset
Spec does not specify the FSM encoding style; I assumed one-hot encoding as a common choice for FPGA/ASIC FSMs and noted it in encoding

The spec states the encrypt phase auto-starts 'on the cycle the 144th bit is shifted in'; I assumed this means the encrypt phase begins on the same rising edge that captures the 144th bit, so the first round executes on that same cycle

Spec does not explicitly state whether the unload counter resets if shift_out_en is deasserted mid-unload; I assumed the unload counter pauses (does not increment) when shift_out_en is low, allowing partial unloading
Spec does not define the initial value of dout after reset; I assumed it is 0

The key schedule description uses 'key_reg << 61' which for an 80-bit register means a left shift by 61 positions, equivalent to a left rotation by 61 (or right rotation by 19); I confirmed this interpretation from the alternative expression '(key_reg >> 19)' in the spec
Spec does not state whether load_en being asserted during the encrypt phase causes any side effect; I assumed it is ignored during encryption to preserve correctness

Spec does not clarify if state and key_reg are cleared on reset or only the FSM and done signal; I assumed all internal registers (state, key_reg, counters) are cleared on reset for deterministic behaviour

behavior_invariants.condition: Whenever rst_n is deasserted (logic 0), done must be driven to 0 on the same clock edge (asynchronously), any in-progress encryption is abandoned, and the FSM returns to the idle state regardless of other inputs
behavior_invariants.description: Asynchronous active-low reset immediately clears done and returns FSM to idle
behavior_invariants.name: reset_clears_done

behavior_invariants.condition: While load_en is high, on each rising edge of clk the module shifts din into the concatenated shift register {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]} MSB-first; the first 80 bits received become key_reg (key[79] arrives first), the next 64 bits become state (plaintext[63] arrives first); after exactly 144 such edges the load phase is complete
behavior_invariants.description: Serial load requires exactly 144 rising edges with load_en high to capture key then plaintext
behavior_invariants.name: load_phase_144_cycles

behavior_invariants.condition: On the rising edge that completes the 144th serial load bit, the module transitions to the encrypt phase without any external trigger; no additional load_en pulse is needed
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption begins automatically on the clock cycle that the 144th bit is shifted in
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_auto_starts

behavior_invariants.condition: During the encrypt phase, each clock cycle executes one round in the sequence: addRoundKey (XOR state with key_reg[79:16]), sBoxLayer (apply 4-bit S-box to each of the 16 nibbles of state), pLayer (permute bits according to P(i)=(i*16) mod 63 for i in 0..62 and P(63)=63), then key schedule update (61-bit left rotate of key_reg, S-box on key_reg[79:76], XOR key_reg[19:15] with round counter); after round 31 a final addRoundKey is applied without sBoxLayer, pLayer, or key schedule update, completing the ciphertext in state
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption executes exactly 31 full rounds followed by one final addRoundKey, totalling 32 clock cycles
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_31_rounds_plus_final_ark

behavior_invariants.condition: For input nibble x in 0..15, the S-box output is: 0->C, 1->5, 2->6, 3->B, 4->9, 5->0, 6->A, 7->D, 8->3, 9->E, A->F, B->8, C->4, D->7, E->1, F->2; this mapping is applied independently to all 16 nibbles of state during sBoxLayer
behavior_invariants.description: The 4-bit S-box maps each nibble according to the PRESENT specification
behavior_invariants.name: sbox_mapping

behavior_invariants.condition: Bit i of the pre-pLayer state is placed at position P(i) of the post-pLayer state, where P(i) = (i multiplied by 16) modulo 63 for i from 0 to 62 inclusive, and P(63) = 63
behavior_invariants.description: The pLayer permutes state bits according to P(i)=(i*16) mod 63 for i in 0..62 and P(63)=63
behavior_invariants.name: player_permutation

behavior_invariants.condition: The 80-bit key_reg is rotated left by 61 bit positions each round: the new key_reg equals the concatenation of key_reg[18:0] as the most-significant 19 bits and key_reg[79:19] as the remaining 61 bits
behavior_invariants.description: Key schedule rotates key_reg left by 61 bits (equivalently right by 19 bits) each round
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_rotate

behavior_invariants.condition: After the 61-bit rotation, key_reg[79:76] is replaced by S(key_reg[79:76]) using the same 4-bit S-box as sBoxLayer
behavior_invariants.description: After rotation, the top 4 bits of key_reg are replaced by their S-box output
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_sbox

behavior_invariants.condition: After the S-box substitution on key_reg[79:76], the 5-bit round counter value i (ranging from 1 to 31) is XORed into key_reg[19:15]
behavior_invariants.description: The 5-bit round counter is XORed into key_reg bits 19 down to 15 after S-box substitution
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_round_counter_xor

behavior_invariants.condition: done transitions to 1 on the clock edge that completes the final addRoundKey (32nd encrypt cycle) and remains 1 until rst_n is deasserted or load_en causes a new load phase to begin
behavior_invariants.description: done is asserted after the 32nd encrypt cycle and held until reset or a new load begins
behavior_invariants.name: done_asserted_after_encrypt

behavior_invariants.condition: On each rising edge of clk where both done and shift_out_en are high, the module outputs the next most-significant remaining bit of state[63:0] on dout; the first bit output is state[63] (ciphertext[63]), and subsequent bits follow in descending order; after 64 such edges the full ciphertext has been shifted out
behavior_invariants.description: While done is high and shift_out_en is high, ciphertext is shifted out MSB-first one bit per clock
behavior_invariants.name: unload_serial_msb_first

behavior_invariants.condition: The value of dout is only guaranteed to be a valid ciphertext bit when both done and shift_out_en are high on a rising clock edge; at all other times dout may be any value
behavior_invariants.description: dout is not required to carry valid data when shift_out_en is low or done is low
behavior_invariants.name: dout_stable_when_not_unloading

behavior_invariants.condition: If load_en is asserted while done is high, the module transitions back to the load phase, done is cleared, and the shift register begins accepting new key and plaintext bits
behavior_invariants.description: Asserting load_en while done is high begins a new load phase and clears done
behavior_invariants.name: new_load_aborts_done

behavior_invariants.condition: For key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0x0000000000000000 the ciphertext must be 0x5579C1387B228445; for key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0x0000000000000000 the ciphertext must be 0xE72C46C0F5945049; for key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF the ciphertext must be 0xA112FFC72F68417B; for key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF the ciphertext must be 0x3333DCD3213210D2
behavior_invariants.description: The module must produce correct ciphertext for all four specified PRESENT-80 test vectors
behavior_invariants.name: test_vector_correctness

clock_domains.name: clk
clock_domains.notes: Single clock domain; all registers clocked on rising edge; 10 ns target period for gf180mcuD PDK

port_assumptions.notes: Rising-edge triggered; 100 MHz target (10 ns period)
Asynchronous assertion (level-sensitive), synchronous release relative to clk
Must be held high for exactly 144 consecutive rising edges to complete a load; assumed not asserted during encrypt phase
Valid only when load_en is high; MSB of key arrives first (bit 79), followed by MSB of plaintext (bit 63)
Effective only when done is also high; may be held low to pause unloading
Valid ciphertext bit only when done and shift_out_en are both high on a rising edge; MSB (ciphertext[63]) first
Asserted after 32 encrypt cycles complete; held until rst_n=0 or new load_en pulse
